Regional Football Pathways | Preparation guidance reviewed 18 October 2026
Recommended template, not a universal club requirement. Follow the receiving club’s instructions.
Replace bracketed text; delete irrelevant fields. Do not send this uncompleted template.

COACH REFERENCE WORKSHEET
Player: [name]
Intended recipient / purpose: [club or pathway assessment]

TO BE COMPLETED OR APPROVED BY THE REFEREE
Referee: [name]
Role / club or programme: [details]
Relevant qualifications, if held: [details]
Coaching relationship: [dates, frequency, training and/or match observation]
Player's positions and competition: [details]

Suggested opening:
I have coached [player] at [club/programme] since [date], observing them in [context]. They primarily play [position] in [competition].

Strength 1 and observed example: [details]
Strength 2 and observed example: [details]
Strength 3, if useful: [details]
Decision-making and off-ball contribution: [examples]
Response to pressure and feedback: [examples]
Reliability, teamwork and coachability: [examples]
Current development priorities: [balanced assessment]
Additional context / limits of observation: [details]

I approve this assessment and agree to be contacted about it via:
[Professional email or other agreed contact]
[Name, signature, date]

Family: obtain permission before sharing contact details. Do not invent qualifications, signatures or endorsements. One strong football reference is a useful starting point; no universal requirement for two references was identified.
